UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public directory profile for searching users by username and managing friend connections. Contains no GPS coordinates.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name chosen by the user.

username.description: Unique handle for friend search (lowercase alphanumeric and underscores).

email.description: User email address from Google Authentication.

photoURL.description: User profile photo URL from Google Authentication.

avatarColor.description: Hex color used for user avatar badge and map marker.

sharingEnabled.description: Whether the user currently has live location sharing turned ON.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserLocation.title: UserLocation
UserLocation.description: Private live GPS location document readable ONLY by the owner and accepted friends when sharingEnabled is true.

uid.description: UID of the user sharing their location.

latitude.description: GPS latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: GPS longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest GPS location update.

heading.description: Device heading in degrees if available.

speed.description: Device speed in meters/second if available.

sharingEnabled.description: Must be true for accepted friends to read location.

allowedFriendUids.description: List of accepted friend UIDs authorized to read this location.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest GPS fix.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest GPS fix.

FriendRequest.title: FriendRequest
FriendRequest.description: Friend request record between two users.

status.description: Current status of the friend request.

/users/{userId}.description: User directory profile storing name, email, profile photo, user ID, location sharing status, friends list, and account creation time.

/locations/{userId}.description: Strictly private live GPS location document accessible only to the user and their accepted friends.
